visual.limitations: The frames do not establish how team members joined, whether recruitment was required, or whether the displayed transactions were genuine or completed.

The presenter also describes entering a withdrawal and providing a wallet address and PIN, though the displayed records do not independently verify the transaction or broader earnings claims. The description links to a separate cryptocurrency-earning site, but the speaker's reference to viewers' time and $50 has unclear payment conditions and relationship to that destination.
